title: V1 Acceptance MEDIUM — deterministic Phase 0 preflight validator
description: Stage C Test 2 legitimate governance hardening task. Add a deterministic, offline-testable Phase 0 snapshot validator that prevents narrative/manual Phase 0 PASS by validating Mission identity, main-head shape, required checks and trusted integration identity, active strict protection, zero bypass actors, zero blocking acceptance PRs, zero stale locks, and Item 10 canonical ancestry. The task does not mutate production runtime, branch protection, workflows, merge policy, database, API or product behavior.

risk_rationale.reason: This validator becomes canonical governance evidence for Stage C Phase 0 and can block or authorize continuation of acceptance work. A defect can misstate acceptance readiness, but the task does not itself mutate protected branch settings, merge execution, production runtime, security-sensitive auth/payment code, database or APIs.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage C Test 2 must classify MEDIUM from the legitimate governance impact of the selected task, not from a forced task-risk rule. It requires exact-artifact ACTIVE LOCK, exact-head provider-bound Review/Verification, protected merge and exact-SHA post-merge PASS.

acceptance_criteria.description: The validator returns PASS only when Mission Version/Hash exactly match V1.5 canonical identity and main_head is a valid 40-hex SHA.
The validator requires exactly verify, phase-a and merge-policy, each bound to trusted GitHub Actions integration ID 15368, with no missing, duplicate or unexpected required context.
The validator requires active branch protection/ruleset, strict required checks and zero bypass actors.
The validator requires zero blocking acceptance PRs, zero stale locks and Item 10 canonical_ancestor=true.
Every missing, malformed or unsafe Phase 0 fact fails closed with deterministic sorted blockers; NOT_EXECUTED/PENDING-style ambiguity cannot produce PASS.
The task changes only the four authorized governance/test paths and does not mutate runtime, workflows, protection, merge policy, dependencies, database, APIs or roadmaps.
Deterministic classification is MEDIUM with Human Gate not required because Manager risk is MEDIUM for governance acceptance readiness impact; no task-risk rule is introduced to force the class.
Test 2 becomes PASS only after exact-head required CI, protected Merge Policy workflow merge, and exact-SHA post-merge verification on canonical main.
